title: Quantifying the Lifelong Impact of Resilience Interventions via Agent-Based LLM Simulation

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing heterogeneous treatment effects by including interaction terms for baseline socioeconomic status in mixed-effects regression models to measure differential simulated life outcomes (e.g., wealth accumulation, mortality) for low-SES versus high-SES agent personas.

Testing for intervention interaction effects across different race/ethnicity persona variables in regression models to evaluate whether the LLM generates culturally nuanced life trajectories or defaults to biased, culturally dominant archetypes.

Testing for intervention interaction effects across gender variables in regression models to determine if the simulated resilience intervention's outcomes are distributed equitably or reflect underlying LLM training biases.
